title: Applicability Check at BUILD Pattern Reuse
summary: The BUILD skill (and `/rdd-refactor` when extending existing patterns) gains an Applicability Check, a stewardship-checkpoint prompt that fires when an existing pattern is explicitly referenced as the template for new code — the one operative trigger; structural-similarity and stewardship-flag detection are named as aspirational triggers with no current substrate. The check asks four composed questions (name a structural alternative; what's different about the new context; which original-context assumptions carry forward; which fitness properties does system-design.md declare, per ADR-076) and treats the user's substantive response as the load-bearing artifact. It is a Tier 2 conversational mechanism per ADR-058, addressing the BUILD-phase share of the Einstellung-effect failure chain named in Issue #13.
mechanism: four-prompt Applicability Check triggered on explicit pattern-reuse reference

links.note: the user's response is the load-bearing artifact, following ADR-055's belief-mapping principle that the question form is the structural intervention and the user's substantive response is the evidence
classifies the applicability check as a Tier 2 conversational mechanism per ADR-058's two-tier sycophancy-resistance taxonomy, accepting reduced enforceability relative to structural mechanisms
the unassessable-risk fallback (offer grounding actions; record the decision visibly) follows ADR-068's Grounding Reframe extension when applicability-check prompts cannot be answered substantively
the operative-vs-aspirational trigger split follows ADR-069's honest scope-of-claim standard — naming triggers that don't exist would create a reliability expectation the implementation cannot meet

ADR-075 (preservation scenarios, DECIDE) and this ADR are first- and second-line defenses against the same Issue #13 failure chain; ADR-075 is the structural, mechanically-anchored layer while this ADR is the cognitive layer at the BUILD application moment

prompt 4 explicitly consumes ADR-076's fitness-property output ("Which fitness properties does system-design.md declare for the affected module(s)?"), making the ARCHITECT-time decomposition load-bearing at the BUILD pattern-reuse moment
